criteria.evidence: Section 1 explicitly asks 'What capability is actually missing?' and lists concrete capabilities (tracing, dashboards, cost tracking, alerting) to check against current setup.
Section 2 and the ladder ('Smallest adequate solution') explicitly favor reusing/extending existing logging (structured logging, self-generated trace/span IDs) before adopting a new framework.
Section 3 explicitly lists 'new dependency surface, often a hosted/SaaS component..., configuration and maintenance burden, and sometimes vendor lock-in' as costs of adding it now.
